purpose: Document official ATR/BPN cadastral service discovery and a bounded safe geometry response for Rangkasbitung.
assessment: The national ATR/BPN GeoServer WFS exposes bhumi:Persil anonymously and returned three polygons in the tested bbox. Local registry custody is separately evidenced by a public official land-office notice naming Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Lebak in Rangkasbitung. Geometry is a bounded sample only; runtime remains held.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Anonymous WFS capabilities response lists bhumi:Persil and advertises GeoJSON output and EPSG:3857 as the default layer CRS.
Official help material describes parcel layers as a main BHUMI dataset and ATLAS as the centralized geospatial platform.
Public official notice names Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Lebak and its Rangkasbitung address; used only as local custodian evidence.

attempts.assessment: Official BHUMI shell reachable; it delegates map content to the official console.
Schema returned; geometry element is batas and safe response was limited to geometry plus service feature ID.
Three polygon features returned; full geometry retained in sample file only, with exactly one canonical id property per feature.
REST layer administration endpoint is protected; not pursued.

geometryEvidence.nativeIdField: service feature id (not a retained source attribute column)
geometryEvidence.exactWupPointTest: No exact-point hit test was used; a 0.02-degree bbox around the exact immutable WUP point was used without moving it.
geometryEvidence.requestEvidence: The bounded GetFeature request above returned three polygon features.

sourceFieldMapping.reason: Native attributes were not retained; owner, title, address, valuation, and other unsafe or unnecessary fields were excluded.

nextStep: Hold for serial review and independent adapter qualification.
